name: NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. is a prominent financial services company with operations in South Korea and across international markets. Its core activities encompass wealth management, investment banking, proprietary trading, and equity sales. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of investment products and asset management services, including shares, diverse funds, and structured instruments like ELS/DLS. Its corporate finance segment offers robust solutions in both debt and equity capital markets, complemented by digital sales services. Furthermore, it actively invests in, trades, and distributes various financial instruments such as equities, fixed income securities, and FICC derivative products. Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1969, the firm operated as Woori Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. until its name change to NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. in December 2014. It functions as a subsidiary of NongHyup Financial Group Inc.
